messages: anya: Quick sync 1 playground streaming + prompt library tweaks. Main asks: (A) clarify Pause vs Stop behaviour in UI and copy, (B) try token counter as a trailing pill inside composer (collapses to icon when idle), (C) Stop should keep partial output editable as a client-only draft, (D) prompt quick-insert shortcut (Cmd+K) with inline insert. Prototype: https://figma.com/redwood/playground-stream-v3 ben: Re microcopy: propose short labels for mobile and long labels for desktop. Desktop: `Pause (hold stream)` / `Stop (save draft)`; Mobile: `Pause` / `Stop`. Also suggest putting controls inline above composer rather than inside message rail. ben: UX for token pill: show live token count while streaming, then compress to a small circular badge with tooltip. On regenerate show a transient delta badge like `+42`. maria: Product constraints: preserved partials must not auto-send and should be flagged `stopped_partial=true` in client metadata. Regenerate should create a new generation entry in the conversation timeline (do not clobber the old partial). maria: Prompt drawer flow: Cmd+K to open, type to filter, Enter to insert. If composer focused, insert at caret; if not, append as new draft message. Need to handle when selection is in middle of text. sam: Implementation notes: Pause = pause streaming on client (keep the backend stream open); Stop = cancel server generation (server frees KV/alloc). Important billing note: even on Stop, server must emit final `tokens_consumed` so billing reflects work done. We'll add `generation.outcome=stopped_partial` to traces. sam: For token delta display we can consume final token count from the server event. If Stop cancels early, event should include `aborted: true` so UI can show `+12 (aborted)`. Also Pause will need a lightweight keepalive ping over WS to avoid timeouts. linda: A11y checklist: controls must be tabbable in logical order, token pill must be in the tab sequence and have `role=status` + `aria-live=polite`. Announce changes like "Streaming paused", "Generation stopped 1 partial available". Examples: ``` Tokens: 98 ``` linda: For the prompt drawer ensure keyboard nav wraps and that screen readers can read the prompt description on focus. Also include high contrast icons for the token pill. ben: Edge behaviour question: if a user hits Stop and edits the preserved partial, then hits Regenerate, should the new generation run against the edited text or original prompt? My vote: Regenerate should use the visible composer text (i.e., user's edited version) and create a new generation entry. We should surface a small note: "Running regenerate on edited draft." maria: Agreed with ben. We'll document that in the flows. Also add a small rollback affordance: revert to original partial via ellipsis menu. tom: QA note: test low-bandwidth condition for Pause (does it block visuals?) and mobile with limited screen real estate — token pill collapse behaviour needs to be tested on 320px widths. anya: Action list: 1) ben update Figma frames with inline controls + collapsing token pill (ETA today), 2) sam spike abort flag + final tokens event (ETA 2d), 3) maria update product flows + draft vs regen rules and add a revert affordance (ETA 1d), 4) linda produce a11y test matrix and copy recommendations (ETA 2d), 5) tom add QA test cases for mobile and low-bandwidth (ETA 3d). I'll schedule a 30m sync Mon 10am PT to review. ben: will push frames and tag this thread when done. :thumbsup: maria: I'll prep the regen/draft docs and share in this thread. sam: will start backend spike and follow up with implementation notes. linda: will draft aria strings and keyboard mappings, post checklist. tom: adding QA tickets and will ping test infra for device coverage. deploy-bot: Reminder: "Playground streaming design review" on Mon 10:00 PT. React with :+1: if attending. anya: thanks everyone, leaving thread open for follow-ups.
